h:
大家好！
首先，感谢您分享您的工作流程 - 看到人们如何混合和匹配工具以将他们的创意变为现实，这总是很酷。我想分享我自己的过程，以及一些可能对其他人有帮助的技巧和资源。让我们深入了解一下！

  1. 用于升级的 Topaz 视频 AI
    在发布混元视频之前，我使用 Topaz Video AI 对其进行升级。它是提高视频质量并保持一切清晰的绝佳工具。我对美学有点执着，所以在我把任何东西放在那里之前，升级对我来说是必须的。

  2. 受到社区的启发
    需要澄清的是，我的工作流程并非完全是我自己想出来的。这是我从社区中收集到的想法的混合体——我只是将它们组合在一起，并试图让它们为我服务。如果有人在这里发现他们的贡献，请随时大声喊出来！我非常感谢大家分享的所有灵感和知识。

  3. 我使用的 LoRA（不在 CivitAI 上）

  • Accvid 5 步骤：这个 LoRA 是加快我的流程的救星——它让我只需 5 个步骤即可完成工作。但我注意到，在完成提示后将其提高到 30-40 个步骤会对质量产生巨大影响。

  • HYVrewardMPS：这可以帮助我创建更好的角色并更接近我的提示。我发现以 0.5 的强度使用它最适合我的工作流程。

  1. 让我们一起不断进步
    我相信你们中的一些人会找到调整和改进此工作流程的方法，我很乐意看到这种情况发生！这就是我们成长和学习的方式——通过借鉴彼此的想法。

在哪里可以找到 LoRA:

  • Accvid LoRA: 在这里下载

  • HYVrewardMPS LoRA: 在这里下载

CivitAI 快速说明:
我听说了 CivitAI 的支付系统问题，只是想说我支持他们尽快解决这个问题。希望他们能够添加更多支付选项，让每个人的生活再次变得更加轻松。

这就是我的！祝大家创作愉快——迫不及待地想看看你们的创意！

要接收我的工作流程，只需将我可爱机器人的 json 文件拖到您的 ComfyUI 中即可！

o.en:
Hey everyone!
First off, thanks for sharing your workflows—it’s always so cool to see how people mix and match tools to bring their creative ideas to life. I thought I’d share my own process, along with some tips and resources that might help others. Let’s dive in!

  1. Topaz Video AI for Upscaling
    I use Topaz Video AI to upscale my Hunyuan videos before publishing them. It’s a fantastic tool for boosting video quality and keeping everything looking sharp. I’m a bit of a stickler for aesthetics, so upscaling is a must for me before I put anything out there.

  2. Inspired by the Community
    Just to be clear, my workflow isn’t something I came up with entirely on my own. It’s a mix of ideas I’ve picked up from the community—I just put them together and tried to make them work for me. If anyone spots their contributions in here, feel free to shout them out! I’m super grateful for all the inspiration and knowledge shared by everyone.

  3. LoRAs I Use (Not on CivitAI)

  • Accvid 5 Steps: This LoRA is a lifesaver for speeding up my process—it lets me work with just 5 steps. But I’ve noticed that bumping it up to 30-40 steps after finalizing my prompts makes a huge difference in quality.

  • HYVrewardMPS: This one helps me create better characters and stick closer to my prompts. I’ve found that using it at a strength of 0.5 works best for my workflow.

  1. Let’s Keep Improving Together
    I’m sure some of you will find ways to tweak and improve this workflow, and I’d love to see that happen! That’s how we all grow and learn—by building on each other’s ideas.

Where to Find the LoRAs:

  • Accvid LoRA: Download here

  • HYVrewardMPS LoRA: Download here

Quick Note on CivitAI:
I heard about the payment system issues at CivitAI and just wanted to say I’m rooting for them to sort it out soon. Hopefully, they’ll add more payment options to make things easier for everyone again.

That’s it from me! Happy creating, everyone—can’t wait to see what you all come up with!

To receive my workflow just drag the json file of my cute robot into your ComfyUI!
